## What you did
You identified that the iOS SDK 3.2.0 regression replaced global UUIDs with per-session counters, causing massive legitimate event drops and triggering Orbitly’s funnel decline [1]. You authored PR #247 to correct the deduplication key, alerted the mobile team to restore UUIDs, and queued a landing-data replay to recover ~1.18M lost events for Orbitly once deployed [1].

## What changed
Maya requested the precise drop volume to prepare for Thursday’s client sync [2]. Zest Grocers confirmed their pilot dashboard is fully restored following the backfill [6]. The 12/11 ingestion postmortem is finalized and locked for Friday’s incident review [3].

## What is still open
Merge and deploy #247, then immediately run the scheduled replay for Orbitly and Zest, confirming the drop counter normalizes [1]. Publish the validated loss metrics to Maya before Thursday’s Orbitly call [2]. Implement the dead-letter queue threshold alert (>1,000 messages) ahead of Friday’s review [7].
